name: Birmingham
seoTitle: Website Audit Birmingham — Free AI Website Health Check
metaDescription: Free AI website audit for Birmingham businesses. Find out exactly what's stopping your site from winning more local enquiries.
intro: As the UK's second-largest city, Birmingham has a large and varied local search market spanning the city centre and surrounding boroughs like Solihull, Sutton Coldfield and Dudley — businesses that only optimise for "Birmingham" broadly are leaving a lot of specific, winnable local search traffic on the table.
painPoints: Broad "Birmingham" targeting missing more specific, less competitive searches from Solihull, Sutton Coldfield, Dudley and other surrounding areas
Website trust signals (reviews, accreditations, business details) not kept current as the business grows across a wider service area
Mobile experience issues going unnoticed despite Birmingham's high proportion of mobile local searches
Missing structured data that would help the business appear in Google's local map pack alongside organic results

faq.question: Is it worth targeting areas around Birmingham like Solihull or Sutton Coldfield separately?
faq.answer: Yes — these are large, distinct search markets in their own right, and dedicated content for each lets you compete for local searches you'd otherwise miss with generic Birmingham-only targeting.

faq.question: What's the biggest local SEO opportunity for Birmingham businesses?
faq.answer: Completing and actively maintaining a Google Business Profile alongside consistent NAP (name, address, phone) details across the website — this combination is what drives visibility in Google's local map pack, which sits above organic results for most local searches.

faq.question: How do I check if my Birmingham business website is mobile-friendly?
faq.answer: Our free audit specifically checks viewport configuration, responsive layout, and touch target sizing — run it on your site to get an instant mobile-friendliness assessment.
